title: ceropegia neocompta
intro: Ceropegia neocompta, commonly known as the "Tiger's Jaw" or "String of Hearts," is a flowering succulent plant native to South Africa. This plant is known for its unique, heart-shaped leaves that grow on long stems and its vibrant, red-and-yellow flowers. The health benefits of Ceropegia neocompta include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression, thanks to its therapeutic actions in promoting relaxation and calmness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
